prompt: python dict.values() view equality comparison result
answer:
An equality comparison between two `dict.values()` views always returns `False`, even when they contain the same values. This also applies when comparing a values view to itself:

```python
d = {'a': 1}

d.values() == d.values()  # False
```

To compare the values, convert the views to comparable collections, such as lists:

```python
list(dict1.values()) == list(dict2.values())
```

This compares values in their iteration order.
